regions.name: South Georgia and South Sandwich Is.

recipe.ghg_method: Fossil CO2 summed across seven native fuel accounts. Source Mt CO2eq converted to tonnes using 1e6. CO2 has GWP 1 under AR5 and AR6; no CH4, N2O or F-gases are included. No direct final-demand emissions are supplied.
recipe.gdp_basis: GDP proxy: value added (no product-tax detail in source)
recipe.gdp_note: EMERGING: GDP is approximated by value added. The source table does not break out product taxes, so no adjustment to market prices is applied.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the native value added row. The source table does not break out product taxes separately.
recipe.attribution: Huo, J.; Wang, W.; Guan, D. EMERGING 2.2, 2015. doi:10.5281/zenodo.19461860. CC BY 4.0; indicators calculated with MARIO.
recipe.ghg_basis: Fossil CO2 by fuel; incomplete GHG proxy
recipe.gwp_basis: CO2 only (GWP = 1 under AR5 and AR6)
recipe.ghg_note: EMERGING: GHG is a fossil CO2-only proxy (seven fuel accounts). CH4, N2O, F-gases and direct final-demand emissions are not included.

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied. EMERGING reports one household consumption category; its NPISH coverage is undocumented. The displayed value is the reported household amount, not a verified complete SNA Households + NPISH amount. No missing NPISH amount is treated as zero.
